messages.author: c4b09b129d99cc26
messages.subject: Averaging models in NIMBLE
parts:
Hi all,

I am fitting the BYM model on several simulated data sets in NIMBLE. Is there an option to average over these models to get one set of parameter estimates?

Thank you!

Best regards,
Hanah.

messages.author: bebd85531a67ef86
messages.subject: Re: Averaging models in NIMBLE
parts:
Hi Hanah

I'll assume that you are fitting the models via MCMC, that the MCMC mixing is equally good for each model, and that you have the same number of samples (and similar effective sample sizes) per model. Section 7.6 of the manual covers how to extract samples for a single model. You will simply need to extract your samples for each of your N models, combine those N matrices into a single matrix (e.g. using rbind) and perform all further analyses with this new matrix.  If memory becomes an issue due to matrix size (i.e. nrow becoming big) then simply define some thinning rule to reduce matrix size.  

Hope that helps
David
